title: Command, Approved Example, and Inference Cards
body_markdown:
# Command, Approved Example, and Inference Cards

Classify each statement.

- First Corinthians 16:2 instructs a first-day collection.
- Acts 20:7 reports a first-day gathering to break bread.
- The Troas meeting was upstairs.
- Every church must meet upstairs.
- A necessary inference must follow from the evidence.
- We conclude this practice from an apostolic pattern.
- Every action recorded in Acts is automatically approved.
- Context and genre affect normative weight.
